description: This file contains a set of shell script tests for verifying GPG signature verification functionality during git pull operations, including different scenarios like signed commits, bad signatures, untrusted signatures, and various trust levels.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A function to define a successful test case with a descriptive label and a command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: A function that expects a command to fail; used to verify error conditions.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: A function to search for specific text in command output, verifying expected error or success messages.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: A cleanup function executed when the test finishes, to reset environment or clean temporary data.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: A function to set specific configuration options for testing.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: A function to set global configuration options for testing.
